$comment: builtin-baseline pins every port (and its transitives: protobuf, openssl, abseil, ...) to the versions at that microsoft/vcpkg commit, so local and CI build identical dependencies. CI clones vcpkg at this same commit (VCPKG_COMMIT in .github/workflows) — keep the two in sync when bumping. With the vcpkg toolchain active, these install automatically into <build>/vcpkg_installed at configure time.
